description: Source code implementing fused moving average observation and fake quantization for quantized tensors in PyTorch, including functions for calculating moving averages, choosing quantization parameters, and performing the fused operation.

methods.name: calculate_moving_average
methods.description: Calculates the moving average of min and max values for a tensor, supporting per-row quantization.

methods.name: choose_qparams_fake_quant
methods.description: Selects quantization parameters and performs fake quantization on a tensor, supporting per-channel and per-tensor modes.

methods.name: fused_moving_avg_obs_fake_quant_cpu
methods.description: Performs fused moving average observation and fake quantization on CPU tensors, with support for per-channel quantization and dynamic min/max calculation.

methods.name: fused_moving_avg_obs_fake_quant
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls the CPU implementation, returns quantized tensor or original with mask.
